ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 92% of the visible surface area, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, yielding a low macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The primary surface is composed of contiguous low-intensity dark pigment. High-contrast white circular and ring-like geometric blobs are concentrated in the proximal and distal regions of the left lobe. Discrete high-intensity linear segments are mapped to the central and lateral regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle and minimal pixel depth relative to the vertical axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The continuous trailing boundary exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. A distinct localized indentation (approx. 15 pixels deep) is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves fitted to the outer trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel formations (diameters ranging 3-12 pixels) on the upper-left lobe; sparse distribution of similar individual circular high-intensity points across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast linear pixel streaks (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the right lobe surface and shorter horizontal segments across the mid-left lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Surface contains extensive circular ring-shaped scarring and unaligned linear rake marks. A notable irregular indentation is present on the superior margin of the left lobe near the center.
